The petitioners vide the present petitions under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 read with Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeks quashing of FIR No.390/2022 dated 17.06.2022 registered under Sections 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and the Final Report dated 11.03.2024 at PS.: Prashant Vihar, Delhi pending before learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Rohini Courts, North, New Delhi and subsequent proceedings emanating therefrom.

sentences.text: Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
She seeks, and is granted, two weeks time to file the Status Report along with SCRB/ NCRB report.

6. On the petitioners taking all the requisite steps within a period of one week, issue notice to the respondent no.2 by all permissible modes, returnable on 03.04.2025.
7.
Re -notify on 03.04.2025.

The applicants vide the present applications under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 read with Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seek stay of the proceedings in the Case bearing Cr. Case No. 3553/2024 titled as "State vs. Rajesh Kapoor & Ors.",
which is pending before the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Rohini Courts, North, New Delhi.
9.

sentences.text: As per learned counsel for the applicants, considering the nature of the dispute involved which are primarily relating to the property bearing This is a digitally signed order.

10. Accordingly, re-notify on 03.04.2025 for the personal presence of all the private parties either physically or through video conferencing.
